hero.slogan: Interwoven ventures exploring paths to a distant viable future
hero.p1: Earth’s habitable conditions for human civilization will not last forever. Stellar evolution of the Sun is a certain, irreversible process unfolding over billions of years. This is an astronomical observation, not a doomsday warning. At present, humanity has no complete, robust fallback plan for long-term habitable survival.
hero.p2: Venture-Grid exists to hold this quiet, long-range concern. We do not sensationalize collapse. Instead, we build a patient, self-updating AI watcher dedicated to this intergenerational question. Its core purpose is to explore many possible lines of inquiry and gradually reduce the uncertainty around our long-term habitable future.
hero.p3: The system uses a microkernel design, extended by research threads called Ventures. There is no fixed answer, no single escape route we commit to. Each venture can be evaluated, scored, archived, laid dormant, and revived when new evidence emerges. Once every week, the AI runs a full cycle of assessment, literature review and report generation. Everything is open, traceable and reproducible.
hero.p4: This is a loose, voluntary federation. Every independently hosted fork may choose to discover peers and exchange venture data. The owner of each node retains full control over what, if anything, to synchronize. There is no central authority. Nodes share voluntarily and build a shared knowledge base that can lie dormant and be restarted by future people.
hero.p5: There is no mandatory business model baked into the charter. A node operator may run it purely for public good. They may also choose monetization or advertising to cover servers, API costs and labor, as long as they preserve the core charter and do not distort the system’s exploratory purpose. Anyone can submit new research ideas, contribute references, or donate spare compute and server time to sustain this long journey.

about.title: About
about.vgDesc: The platform as a whole: a structured system for holding, assessing, and linking conjectures.
about.ventureDesc: A single independent line of inquiry inside VG, and the smallest unit of assessment. A venture may branch into new ventures, go dormant, or be exported as a fork and continued in another VG instance.
about.batchDesc: A review batch, usually weekly; the time container for scoring and briefs.
about.snapshotDesc: An export bundle containing selected ventures, evidence, links, and score history, used for fork hand-off.
about.anchorDesc: The far target anchor marking the visual end of the graph; a direction reference only, not a required destination.
about.philosophy1: Long-horizon habitability conjecture spans extremely long periods, with sparse evidence and shifting judgement.
about.philosophy2: Venture-Grid does not aim to deliver a final answer. It aims to build an auditable, hand-off capable record.
about.philosophy3: Every assessment carries evidence and a time trail. Anyone who receives a snapshot can continue along the existing line of inquiry.
